The registry probe that classified this payable used POST (status 402), not GET. Tavus creates conversations via POST /v2/conversations, so the working method is almost certainly POST — the GET registration is wrong.
Do NOT retry GET; the route is dead. A future fix should re-register this as POST and re-QA, since POST may also require a body (e.g. {persona_id} or {replica_id}).
usage.guide: As registered (GET https://x402.orth.sh/tavus/v2/conversations) this endpoint is broken: it returns HTTP 404 'No matching endpoint found for GET /v2/conversations' with no payment required. Do not call it as a GET. The Tavus conversations API creates a conversation via POST /v2/conversations (the registry's own probe got a 402 on POST), likely requiring a body such as a persona_id or replica_id, so the registered method/shape is incorrect and must be fixed before this can work.
